entries.title: Existence and compactness of minimizers
entries.summary: The constrained energy infimum is attained in the specified two-dimensional sufficient mass range.
entries.limit: Whole-space minimizer set with compactness modulo translations, not profile uniqueness.
entries.statement:
theorem exists_minimizer (hβ : 0 < β) (hγ : 0 < γ) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hmB : m ≤ StrictBinding.mB β γ k) :
    ∃ U : H2 2, M U = m ∧ energy β γ k U = Imin β γ k m :=

entries.title: Exact minimum of weighted phase-locking energy
entries.summary: Computes the energy minimum and equality conditions for closed-loop phases with prescribed winding.
entries.limit: Requires positive bounded weights and the stated H¹ phase hypotheses.
entries.statement:
theorem phase_locking_exact_minimum (hD : PhaseLockingData S w Ω σ) (m n : ℤ) :
    IsLeast (lockingEnergy S w Ω σ m '' admissiblePhases S n)
        (closureMismatch S Ω σ m n ^ 2 / inverseWeightIntegral S w) ∧
    (∀ χ₀ : ℝ, optimalPhase S w Ω σ m n χ₀ ∈ admissiblePhases S n ∧
        lockingEnergy S w Ω σ m (optimalPhase S w Ω σ m n χ₀) =
          closureMismatch S Ω σ m n ^ 2 / inverseWeightIntegral S w) ∧
    (∀ χ ∈ admissiblePhases S n, lockingEnergy S w Ω σ m χ =
        closureMismatch S Ω σ m n ^ 2 / inverseWeightIntegral S w +
          ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..S, w s *
            (covariantGradient Ω m χ s - optimalGradient S w Ω σ m n s) ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ χ ∈ admissiblePhases S n,
        lockingEnergy S w Ω σ m χ =
            closureMismatch S Ω σ m n ^ 2 / inverseWeightIntegral S w ↔
          covariantGradient Ω m χ =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 S)]
            optimalGradient S w Ω σ m n) ∧
    (∀ χ ∈ admissiblePhases S n,
        lockingEnergy S w Ω σ m χ =
            closureMismatch S Ω σ m n ^ 2 / inverseWeightIntegral S w →
          ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 S, χ s = optimalPhase S w Ω σ m n 0 s + c) :=

entries.title: Whole-space Fourier-shell formalization
entries.summary: Establishes unitary Fourier-transform structure on L² as part of the Fourier-shell exclusion development.
entries.limit: A supporting formal-analysis module overlapping in topic with L2Fourier.lean, not an additional solved GC.

entries.title: Finite preferred linear wavenumber
entries.summary: Establishes a strictly positive minimizing wavenumber for a specified real dispersion branch.
entries.limit: Linear dispersion minimum, not nonlinear wavelength-selection dynamics.
entries.statement:
theorem exact_positive_wavenumber_minimum (h : Base K G T m) (hc : FiniteScale K G m) :
    0 < G ∧ 0 < a K G ∧
    (∀ q z, 0 ≤ d K G T m q →
      (poly K G T m q z = 0 ↔ z = zPlus K G T m q ∨ z = zMinus K G T m q)) ∧
    (∀ q, 0 ≤ q → ((∃ z : ℝ, poly K G T m q z = 0) ↔ q ≤ qColl K G T m)) ∧
    (0 < qStar K G T m ∧ qStar K G T m < G / B K G T ∧ G / B K G T < qColl K G T m) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ Icc 0 (qColl K G T m), q ≠ qStar K G T m →
      zMinus K G T m (qStar K G T m) < zMinus K G T m q) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ Ioo 0 (qColl K G T m),
      deriv (deriv (zMinus K G T m)) q =
          (B K G T * s K m ^ 2 + G ^ 2) / (2 * K * Real.sqrt (d K G T m q) ^ 3) ∧
        0 < deriv (deriv (zMinus K G T m)) q) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ Icc 0 (qColl K G T m), 0 < zMinus K G T m q ∧ 0 < zPlus K G T m q) :=

entries.title: Nonlinear leakage from finite Fourier modes
entries.summary: Shows that stipulated multimode trigonometric subspaces are not invariant under an unprojected nonlinear flow.
entries.limit: Depends on finite mode-set, coefficient and nonlinear-model hypotheses.
entries.statement:
theorem no_multimode_invariance {κ β γ : ℝ} (hγ : γ ≠ 0) {S : Finset (Fin d → ℤ)}
    (hS : 2 ≤ S.card) {a b : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ q ∈ S, p ≠ q ∧ 3 • p - 2 • q ∉ S ∧
      trig {p, q} (twoMode p q a b) ∈ coordSubspace S ∧
      -Complex.I * (γ : ℂ) * (a ^ 3 * (starRingEnd ℂ) b ^ 2) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ τ (u : ℝ → Rd → ℂ), IsClassicalSolution κ β γ τ u → u 0 = trig {p, q} (twoMode p q a b) →
        coeff (u 0) (3 • p - 2 • q) = 0 ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun t => coeff (u t) (3 • p - 2 • q))
          (-Complex.I * (γ : ℂ) * (a ^ 3 * (starRingEnd ℂ) b ^ 2)) 0 ∧
        ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ), u t ∉ coordSubspace S :=

entries.title: High-frequency Sobolev ill-posedness obstruction
entries.summary: Exhibits an unbounded high-frequency evolution mechanism in a specified higher-time-derivative sector.
entries.limit: A particular ultraviolet instability class, not a universal higher-derivative no-go theorem.
entries.statement:
theorem wave_torus_unbounded (hd : 0 < d) (r ℓ t₀ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → ℝ → Rd → ℝ,
      (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Rd => u n p.1 p.2) ∧ ∀ t x, waveOp (u n) t x = 0) ∧
      (∀ n, IsTorusPeriodic (u n)) ∧ (∀ n t, MemJet r (u n) t ∧ MemJet (r + ℓ) (u n) t) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => jetNorm (r + ℓ) (u n) 0) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ n, jetNorm r (u n) t₀ = 1) ∧
      ∀ (S : JetSpace d → JetSpace d) (C : ℝ), (∀ V, ‖S V‖ ≤ C * ‖V‖) →
        ¬∀ n, S (toJet (r + ℓ) (u n) 0) = toJet r (u n) t₀ :=

entries.title: Scalar-gradient Gram tensor cannot be Lorentzian
entries.summary: The real-part scalar-gradient Gram tensor of a complex scalar field has restricted rank and a degenerate positive-semidefinite signature in four dimensions.
entries.limit: Applies to this specific tensor construction, not all scalar-derived effective metrics.
entries.statement:
theorem main (ψ : M → ℂ) (_hψ : ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) 1 ψ)
    (h4 : Module.finrank ℝ E = 4) (p : M) :
    (tensor I ψ p).IsSymm ∧
    (∀ v, 0 ≤ tensor I ψ p v v) ∧
    LinearMap.ker (tensor I ψ p) =
      LinearMap.ker (mfderiv I 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ψ p).toLinearMap ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (tensor I ψ p)) ≤ 2 ∧
    2 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (tensor I ψ p)) ∧
    ¬ (tensor I ψ p).Nondegenerate :=
